description: Two mixers in one module: a four-input X mixer with a level knob on every input, and a four-input Y mixer with one knob on the sum; both are DC-coupled and mix signals between -10V and 10V

params.text: Sets the level of the summed Y inputs at the Y output, on a logarithmic taper
Sets the level of that input in the X mix, on a logarithmic taper

inputs.text: One of the four inputs into the Y mixer
An input into the Y mixer; with nothing patched here the X+ output is fed to it, which makes the Y knob a master level over X and Y together
One of the four inputs into the X mixer

outputs.text: The X mix with its polarity inverted
The X mix and the Y mix added together

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the sum of the four X inputs.
